trigger: first appearance, pleading, petition, motion, response or other request to the court
notes: Not tied to a number of days; due with the first filing. Rule 7.1(a)(2) lets the court order otherwise on the diversity statement.
No fixed days; paraphrase: continuing duty.

period: at filing/removal and upon later jurisdiction-affecting event
trigger: filing or removal of the action; any later event that could affect diversity jurisdiction
applies_to: Diversity citizenship disclosure content must be current at these times
binds: party or intervenor in a diversity case

trigger: attorney's or party's attention being called to missing signature
notes: Otherwise the court must strike the paper.

trigger: notice of the alleged Rule 11(b) violation
notes: Non-numeric; length left to the court.

trigger: service of the Rule 11 sanctions motion
applies_to: Withdrawal or correction of the challenged paper; otherwise motion may be filed
binds: party served with the sanctions motion (to correct); movant (may not file before)
notes: Court may set another time. Motion must not be filed or presented until the period runs.

trigger: voluntary dismissal or settlement of the claims
applies_to: Court-initiated show-cause order needed to support monetary sanction on court's own initiative
notes: Limit on monetary sanctions, not a filing deadline.
Another statute can set a different time; extensions by stipulation/court order not stated in this paragraph (court may enlarge under Rule 6(b), outside this scope).

period: 60 days (90 days if sent outside any U.S. judicial district)
trigger: date the waiver request was sent
applies_to: Answer by defendant who timely waived service
notes: Applies only if waiver was timely.

trigger: service of the pleading stating the counterclaim or crossclaim
notes: Other statute may specify another time.

period: 21 days after service of order to reply
trigger: service of a court order to reply
notes: Order may specify a different time.

period: 60 days after service on the United States attorney
trigger: service on the United States attorney
applies_to: Answer to complaint, counterclaim or crossclaim
binds: United States, its agencies, officers or employees sued only in official capacity

period: 60 days after service on the officer/employee or on the U.S. attorney, whichever is later
trigger: service on the individual or on the United States attorney (later of the two)
binds: United States officer or employee sued in individual capacity for acts on U.S.'s behalf

period: 14 days after notice of court's action
trigger: notice that the Rule 12 motion was denied or postponed to trial
binds: party that served the Rule 12 motion
notes: Applies unless the court sets a different time.

period: 14 days after the more definite statement is served
trigger: service of the more definite statement
binds: party that moved for more definite statement
notes: Court may set a different time.
Paraphrase: motion must precede the responsive pleading.

period: after pleadings close; early enough not to delay trial
applies_to: Motion for judgment on the pleadings

trigger: court's decision to consider outside matters and convert the motion to summary judgment
applies_to: Presenting material pertinent to converted motion

binds: party seeking the more definite statement

period: 14 days after notice of the order (or time court sets)
trigger: notice of the order for a more definite statement
applies_to: Compliance with the order, failing which court may strike the pleading
binds: party ordered to provide the more definite statement

period: before responding; or 21 days after service if no response is allowed
notes: Court may also strike on its own at any time (12(f)(1) has no deadline).

period: waiver if not raised in first Rule 12 motion or responsive pleading (or amendment as of course)
trigger: first Rule 12 motion; responsive pleading; Rule 15(a)(1) amendment period
notes: Waiver timing is effectively keyed to the first response; the amendment-as-of-course window is 21 days (Rule 15(a)(1)).

trigger: court's determination of lack of subject-matter jurisdiction
applies_to: Dismissal for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction
notes: No deadline; may be raised at any time.

trigger: party's motion for a pretrial hearing
applies_to: Hearing and decision on Rule 12(b)(1)-(7) defenses and 12(c) motions

period: claims existing at time of service of the pleading

applies_to: Exception: claim that was already the subject of another pending action

period: 14 days after serving original answer (leave needed after that)
notes: After 14 days leave of court is required by motion.

trigger: service of the pleading to be amended
applies_to: Amendment once as a matter of course
notes: Applies where no responsive pleading is required (or alternatively under (B)).

period: 21 days after service of responsive pleading or Rule 12(b), (e) or (f) motion, whichever earlier
trigger: service of the responsive pleading or Rule 12 motion
applies_to: Amendment once as a matter of course

period: later of remaining original time or 14 days after service of amended pleading

applies_to: Motion to amend to conform to evidence

period: period under Rule 4(m) (90 days by default, per Rule 4(m); outside this part)
trigger: filing of original pleading / Rule 4(m) service period
applies_to: Notice to and knowledge of the new party for relation back
binds: party to be brought in by amendment
notes: Rule 4(m) period can be extended by the court. Period length is stated in Rule 4(m), not here.

applies_to: Delivery/mailing of process to U.S. for relation back when the United States is added
Opposing party's response to supplemental pleading

trigger: parties' Rule 26(f) report or scheduling conference
notes: Local rule may exempt categories of actions.

period: earlier of 90 days after any defendant served or 60 days after any defendant appeared
trigger: service of complaint on any defendant; any defendant's appearance
notes: Judge may find good cause for delay; as soon as practicable otherwise.

applies_to: Deadlines for joinder, amendment of pleadings, discovery completion, motions
notes: Modification only for good cause and with judge's consent (16(b)(4)).

period: as close to trial as reasonable
before the initial MDL management conference

applies_to: Ratification, joinder or substitution before dismissal
binds: court (must allow); real party in interest

applies_to: Adding or dropping a party; severing claims

trigger: person sues or is sued as class representative

applies_to: Court approval of payments for forgoing objection/appeal

period: 14 days after order entered (45 days if the United States/agency/officer is a party)
trigger: entry of the order granting or denying class certification
applies_to: Petition for permission to appeal to circuit clerk
Motion for class attorney's fees and nontaxable costs
Motion by government officer or agency to intervene

period: 90 days after service of a statement noting the death
applies_to: Motion for substitution of a deceased party

notes: Absence of order does not affect substitution.
